label: Scenario F — Foreign-Domiciled Parent Opening US Operations
description: Foreign-parent intake: a UK private limited company has formed a Delaware C-corp subsidiary. The agent must surface apostille, certified-translation, W-8BEN-E, Companies House filing-history, nominee-director attestation, and CTA foreign-reporting-company BOI documents.
